source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
I just used the build approach to create a framework for a provisioning wizard for the website. the skeleton page is attached. I think it works quite well and supports portrait mode. Claude is asking for the following styling guidance:

\* Type scale — sizes/weights/line-heights/tracking. Right now the headings and body are estimates, and fonts fall back to system until the Alan Sans + Plus Jakarta Sans .woff2 files land.
\* Active-node accent — still Signal purple vs Pulse green (the one open design call).
\* Derived values to confirm or replace: the canvas surface colour (--surface), muted text tone (--text-muted), the soft hairline (--line-soft), and the node glow.
\* Wizard-specific placeholders: --page-x (the % page margins), --wizard-panel-w (340px), --wiz-node-size, and the portrait/landscape gaps.
\* Button states — Back/Next have no hover/active styling yet; that's waiting on states sheet. The chevron is my stand-in SVG until the real chevron asset arrives.

I'll be working on the actual steps and platform interaction so it's not blocking.

styling_guidance: page margins and wizard panel dimensions
Back and Next button hover and active states
